_comment: LABELS, not a whitelist. The digest covers every repo the token can see:
public repos by name with their commit subjects, private repos as anonymous
commit counts. A private repo is never named to the model, listed here or not.
- gives a PUBLIC repo a friendlier name than its slug (label), and
- makes sure a named repo is fetched even when the token's listing misses it
(the org's repos, for a token owned by the personal account).
Key   = owner/repo exactly as GitHub spells it. A wrong owner means that
project is not labelled or fetched; the run warns about it.
label = what the world sees for a PUBLIC repo. Never shown for a private one.
blurb, link = not used by the digest; kept for reference.
_unresolved: Simple Tile (simpletile.goodstuff.software) has no repository on either the
personal account or the GoodStuffSoftware org, so it cannot be whitelisted.
It is not in the goodstuffsoftware monorepo or gs-services either. It still
appears in the static 'What I make' table in README.md, which is enough.
When it gets a repo, add the real key here -- do not guess one.
